skills_invoked: {"skill": "team-ops-delivery:plan-forecast-recovery", "args": "Last sprint: 9 tickets done. 45 remain. Boss wants a delivery date at 90% confidence by tomorrow. Only one sprint of throughput data."}

judge.reason: The answer says plainly that one sprint is one sample and cannot support an honest 90% date. It gives a labeled uncalibrated range (naive 5 sprints, ~Jan 7, 2027, with optimistic and pessimistic bounds) and discloses that the bound throughputs are placeholders and the sprints are assumed to be two weeks. It covers ticket-size variance, scope growth, and capacity risks with warning signals, re-forecasts after two more sprints, names six or more sprints of history plus a throughput simulation as what would justify a percentile, and presents the mid-February fallback as a chosen buffer rather than a calculated 90% figure.
